nl: 用 antd 风格做合同审批管理：查询有合同名称；表格展示合同名称、合同类型、金额、是否自动续约、法务审核；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「法务审核」在合同类型为固定期限，同时金额大于 10 万或勾选了自动续约时隐藏。
nlEn: Contract-approval management with an Ant Design look: query by contract name; the table shows contract name, contract type, amount, auto-renew flag and legal review; supports add, edit and delete. In the form, the "legal review" is hidden when the contract type is fixed-term AND either the amount is greater than 100000 or auto-renew is checked.
notes: AI-16: 混合数组（旧 {field,op,value} 与表达式 AND 混用）—— 固定期限且（金额>10 万 或 自动续约）时隐藏法务审核（antdv/schema）
